verdict.rationale: The 01 server executes code and commands on the host computer and supports several clients (ESP32, mobile, desktop). Nothing in the evidence documents running the agent inside a sandboxed VM or container, or any isolated test mode before connecting a real device. The axis applies to a code-executing agent platform, so the lack of evidence makes this none rather than na.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run the agent against a sandboxed VM or container before pointing it at a real device
